answer.reason: The verses tell Esther's deeds in saving her people from Haman's decree, beyond her being queen.

clauses.english: went in to the king unbidden, and he held out the golden sceptre
clauses.quote: the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre

clauses.english: named Haman as the enemy plotting to destroy her people
clauses.quote: The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman.

clauses.english: begged the king to reverse Haman's decree against the Jews
clauses.quote: besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite

doubts: The EST 11 verses (the dream of Mardocheus) are an addition outside the main text and do not name her, so I left them out.
Her being made queen (EST 2:16-17) is left out because the summary already gives her as queen and wife of Ahasuerus.
